title: Search finds vendors, ventures, scrip turn-ins — and every currency
blurb: The Ctrl+K search now covers gil-shop vendors (with their zone, so "merchant limsa" works), retainer venture rewards and crafted collectable turn-ins, each landing on the right row of the Venture Analyzer or Scrip Sources. Currencies were only half-indexed before — Wolf Marks and Fae Fancy were unfindable — and now match the Currency Exchange page exactly. Add a type word to nudge results: "iron ingot recipe" puts the recipe first.
